reply.text:
Mostly nay if size is the goal, and a shrug if it's just about feeling better. Cold water right after lifting can blunt some of the signals your muscles use to adapt, so research tends to show a bit less muscle growth over time when people plunge after every session. If you like it, keep it away from your hard lifting days, or wait a few hours after training. It's also fine as a recovery tool after a long run or a rough week when you care more about feeling fresh than adaptation.

If you've got a heart condition or any medical concern, check with your doctor before you start plunging. Sleep, food and a few easy days will do more for your recovery than the tub will.
